description.content:
Build custom user interfaces for Salesforce data using the same API that powers Lightning Experience. Returns data and metadata in a single response with layout, picklist, and field-level security awareness. Provides record CRUD operations, layout metadata, picklist values, and object information optimized for UI rendering.
